messages:
henry: opened a PR to add a short 'offline installer: proxy-chaining + HSM notes' section. customers hit key-init failures when proxy returned IPv6 addresses. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4381

mika: can you add a tiny reproduce step and the minimal log snippet? that helps triage fast.

henry: pasted reproduce and log: ```
# reproduce with curl through proxy emulating IPv6 address
curl -v --resolve hsm.local:443:2001:db8::5 --proxy http://proxy:3128 https://hsm.local/status
# log
2026-03-11T08:22:10Z error hsm: pkcs11_init failed: CKR_DEVICE_ERROR
2026-03-11T08:22:10Z warn installer: proxy handshake to 2001:db8::5:4141 timed out
```

rookie: note for windows folks: Add hosts file workaround for testing since powershell curl lacks --resolve.

mika: also add a short callout recommending `sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1` only when admins are comfortable; and a test using `ss -tn` to confirm connections.

lint-bot: link-check failed -> broken ref docs/private-installer/hsm-providers not found

henry: replaced with external provider guide and left redirect note. assigning reviewers @mika @rookie — aim to merge after CI passes.

mika: will run linkcheck and spellcheck; ETA ~1.5h.
